contract: README.md: preserve the compact hero, HTML actions and responsive frame; compare the rejected prototype with a more defined free knight before motion.

accessibility.evidence: For the asset change: artwork remains aria-hidden with empty image alt and no focus targets; keyboard Tab moves from Explore tournaments to Meet the Trust with visible focus. New footer attribution links have descriptive names. Text remains visually readable. No motion was added; existing reduced-motion policy passes unit tests. Actual browser preference-change simulation is deferred and explicitly listed below.

responsive.evidence: At requested desktop/tablet/phone overrides, measured client widths 1425/819/375 equal scroll widths. Desktop shows the whole knight below navbar. Narrow layouts have zero canvases, retain the matching image, and introduce no new artwork row or hero height.

loading.evidence: At initial navigation the image and actions remain visible before the deferred canvas reaches ready; production then reaches one ready canvas.

empty.reason: This is a bundled decorative asset, not a user-supplied or empty collection; missing model is handled as an error.

error.evidence: Temporarily unavailable production GLB returns a non-success response. Eligible hero resolves to static with zero canvases and loaded matching image, retaining content and links. Source file restored and URL verified 200 afterwards; model-failure.jpg records the result.

partial.evidence: When enhancement is unavailable the complete server-rendered image, copy and links remain usable; the failed-model browser check and narrow-layout captures show this partial enhancement state.

success.evidence: Production desktop reaches data-scene=ready with exactly one canvas; its pose matches the static image. Tournament navigation reaches Events with zero canvases.

permission.reason: The public decorative scene requests no account, device or user-data permission. The asset licence is documented separately.
